brief: One drawer and one spike, both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching.

requirements.requirement: One drawer and one spike both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching
requirements.evidence: Spike spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0 at junction (0,0)-(0,1)-(1,0) and notch drawer frame notch:0#1,1#notch2 at 1,1 k=2 sitting between pieces piece:0,1,0;full and piece:1,0,0;full. Both meet at the common corner/edge of cell piece:1,0,0;full and are in contact without configurator clash (meshClash clear, both placed together).

finish.summary: Placed L-shaped 3-cell base (0,0,0 +1,0,0 +0,1,0) so empty cell 1,1 has two neighbours to host a notch drawer, and central junction 0,0|0,1|1,0 hosts a spike. Added hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf at 1,1 k2 and addSpike at 0,0|0,1|1,0 – configurator accepted both together (touching, no clash), capped faces and locked joints.

M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
